name: Tribunal Justice
description: Justice Junction brings together a dynamic trio of judges who delve into genuine and captivating cases, sparking lively debates and spirited deliberations. Their diverse perspectives often lead to fascinating disagreements, resulting in a thrilling and unpredictable final ruling.

videos.title: 24-Hour Bakery Business
videos.overview: A friendship/business partnership falls apart when a dessert shop closes only one day after its profitable grand opening due to a communication break down.

videos.title: Friends Don't Catfish Friends
videos.overview: A friendship of over 40 years is destroyed when an investment opportunity turns out to be non-existent. The victim of the alleged ruse claims he was ghosted by his childhood friend after giving him $3500.

videos.title: Hidden Damages
videos.overview: A young woman who served in Afghanistan sues for thousands in emotional distress after going through the ringer with a used car salesman and deathtrap of a car.

videos.title: Adult Pop-Up Store Fail
videos.overview: The owner of an adult online store claims an employee made off with $5,000 worth of products by refusing to return merchandise after a pop-up store event.

videos.title: Violent Roommates
videos.overview: Mutual combat between ex-roommates leads to serious injuries, restraining orders and jailtime. A heated lawsuit over $10K in missing property ensues.

videos.title: Tattoo Bleedover Nightmare
videos.overview: A painful tattoo session leaves a woman suing for the $10K court maximum in damages. She claims the artist maliciously hurt her arm during a tattoo cover-up session due to an argument over creative differences.

videos.title: Dentist Debauchery?
videos.overview: A veteran on a fixed income loans $10K to his down-and-out dentist in order to save his practice from bankruptcy. Alleged business sabotage, a million-dollar hospital bill and 'free' dental work to a younger girlfriend are excuses as to why he can't pay.

videos.title: Home Sweet Home No More
videos.overview: A woman sues her ex-fiancé for the unauthorized and incomplete renovation of her home which left she and their children without a way to bathe. He says that he intended to finish the work but the home environment had become toxic.

videos.title: Vigilante Dognapping Attempt (Part 1)
videos.overview: In this two-part episode, a woman takes the law into her own hands when she and her armed boyfriend force their way into a dog-grooming business to try and regain custody of her service animal. An employee and her children are traumatized by the caught-on-tape incident.

videos.title: Vigilante Dognapping Attempt (Part 2)
videos.overview: In part two, the owner of the dog-grooming business speaks out about the repeated threats posed by this disgruntled client and her boyfriend; he sues for unpaid services. The Judges must decide which litigant can provide a better home for the animal.

videos.title: Ex-Friends with Benefits
videos.overview: A young mother comes to the financial rescue of a new love interest who tells her that his job is in jeopardy. When she asks for repayment, he tells her to take it up in small claims court. The Judges have a field day.

videos.title: Mother and Son Car Crisis
videos.overview: A law enforcement officer sues her son for 'cancelling' his agreement to pay in full for her beloved 2009 Dodge Challenger. Their fight comes to a head when he is involved in a car accident without insurance coverage.

videos.title: Where There's a Will, There's a Way
videos.overview: Eighteen years after his mother's death, a man claims he never received his fair share of the inheritance and sues his sister for damages. She blames him for ruining the sale of their mother's home.

videos.title: The Editors Shuffle
videos.overview: An aspiring writer/director accuses her film editor of ruining her chances to get into film festivals due to his personal drama. He claims her trafficking fantasy/thriller was unorganized and out of sync.

videos.title: Covid Tenant Protection Shutdown
videos.overview: A 72-year-old man from Los Angeles is faced with eviction when his out-of-state landlord is diagnosed with cancer and needs to move back to California for treatment. A heated showdown over tenant rights during the pandemic ensues.

videos.title: Don't Mix Business with Pleasure
videos.overview: Only weeks after meeting on a dating site, a couple decide to go into the resale business together. Without a contract, they dispute everything from start-up costs to a Miami birthday trip and a yacht outing.

videos.title: Property or Priorities (Part 1)
videos.overview: In this two-part episode, a woman in recovery accuses her ex-fiancé of refusing to return her belongings. He counters with accusations of fraud.

videos.title: Property or Priorities (Part 2)
videos.overview: In part two, a woman's serious health issues and related GoFundMe page are called into question when she sues a close friend for personal property. She must also defend against accusations that she tampered with evidence in a trial that granted her a restraining order against her ex-friend.

videos.title: I Smell a Cat!
videos.overview: A woman blames her live-in nephew for property damage caused by his cat and sues him for back rent; he points the finger at her cat and says she was often too intoxicated to remember that he'd paid the rent.

videos.title: I Thought He Was Dead
videos.overview: A social worker for refugees loans a friend $5,000 out of his savings only to be ghosted when he seeks payback. His 'friend' claims the money was a business investment that didn't pan out and that he owes nothing.

videos.title: Pontoon Catfish
videos.overview: A Navy veteran buys a 34-year-old pontoon boat that almost sinks after a family outing; he sues the seller for a refund after three months of ownership. The Judges deliver a surprising verdict.

videos.title: Body Sculpting Fiasco (Part 1)
videos.overview: In this two-part episode, an aesthetician's cancer diagnosis prevents her from providing body sculpting services to a tummy-tuck client but her severe no-refund policy may save her from paying out damages.

videos.title: Body Sculpting Fiasco '(Part 2)
videos.overview: In part two, a woman pays an aesthetician for a 'mommy makeover' but claims the firming, lipo-laser procedure was a fail. She demands a full refund for services rendered despite the aesthetician's health challenges.

videos.title: Group Home Dispute
videos.overview: A tenant says he sought refuge in a group home after suffering an assault only to be accused of having unauthorized sex by the retired psychiatrist who ran the place. The former doctor said he only wanted to help those in need.

videos.title: Covid-Relief Entitlement
videos.overview: During the height of the pandemic, a woman refuses to pay rent because her apartment is in disrepair. Her landlord claims she neglected to reapply for Covid relief.

videos.title: Overflooded & Drained My Account
videos.overview: A couple living in a flood plain sue an unlicensed plumber for costs to repair his allegedly shoddy work. They claim he left their yard a mess and made comments they viewed as racist.

videos.title: The Dumped Dog
videos.overview: A feisty Jack Russell Terrier is accused of eating everything in sight and is 'un-adopted' by her overwhelmed rescue family. When the dog is later found wandering the streets, volunteers from the non-profit animal rescue sue the adoptive family for breach of contract.

videos.title: The Odd Couple 2.0 and No Good Deed
videos.overview: The Judges rule on two cases in this episode. In the first, Covid may have gotten the best of a landlord and tenant when they wage war over the cleanliness of their shared space. He claims she was a neat freak; she admonishes him for his lack of respect for the 'show towels' in the bathroom. Up next, a woman's friend of 30 years neglects to pay her back after she helped him in his time of need.

videos.title: Heated Up Over Cooling Down
videos.overview: Tempers run hot when a homeowner sues an unlicensed contractor for $5K in damages after an allegedly botched air-conditioner installation. Officer Byrd intervenes to restore order in the courtroom.

videos.title: Stroke While Driving? (Part 1)
videos.overview: In this two-part episode, an uninsured driver denies being at fault when his car T-bones into an elderly woman's vehicle at a four-way intersection. The senior suffers a head injury during the collision.

videos.title: Stroke While Driving? (Part 2)
videos.overview: In part two, a medical report after the collision indicates that the elderly driver suffered a mild stroke. The Judges must determine if the stroke contributed to or was a result of the crash. They call upon an accident reconstructionist to testify.

videos.title: Prison Payback
videos.overview: A woman working double-time as a surrogate mother and warehouse employee sues her ex-convict cousin for an unpaid loan. He admits she was the only family member to stand by him during his 7-year prison term but denies owing her a penny.

videos.title: Bully or Good Samaritan?
videos.overview: A woman breaks down in tears over a loan to her niece who accuses her of slander and defamation. The aunt claims her new phone transcribed comments she had made and sent them without her knowledge.

videos.title: Scum Busters
videos.overview: A woman threatens police intervention if a housekeeper returns to her home after allegedly doing a shoddy job of cleaning. The housekeeper submits video evidence that she left the place tidy and claims that she worked for eight hours.

videos.title: Not Living Single
videos.overview: A man accuses his ex-landlord of refusing to verify him as a past tenant; he claims her actions forced his family to live in a motel for months. He sues for return of his security deposit and for displacement expenses.

videos.title: Wedding Contractor or Con Artist?
videos.overview: An engaged couple sue their wedding planner for the court maximum after their dream wedding does not take place. Large payments to vendors are called into question when the planner cannot produce evidence that they took place.

videos.title: Up in Smoke (Part 1)
videos.overview: In part one of this two-part episode, after a raging apartment fire causes over $250K in damages, a tenant accuses her landlord of property theft and demands that her security deposit be returned.

videos.title: Up in Smoke (Part 2)
videos.overview: In part two, the landlord blames his tenant for starting the fire citing her combustible gas cans as the possible flame accelerant. The defendant says she and her daughter were lucky to get out alive.

videos.title: Outrageous Prank
videos.overview: A cruel and disgusting act of revenge involving a small dog is caught on tape when a woman goes after her roommate for allegedly breaking 'girl code.' Soon after, a fight over unpaid rent escalates into physical violence.

videos.title: Mother Knows Best
videos.overview: A former lawyer sues her adult son for falling behind on truck payments; he adds insult to injury by racking up tickets and tolls on the vehicle and by calling her possessive and controlling.

videos.title: Website Fiasco
videos.overview: An entrepreneur hires a former client to create her company's website but when no website materializes, she sues for damages. The Judges applaud her innovative business concept.

videos.title: Experienced Spender
videos.overview: For her 20th birthday, a young woman pays for a friend to join her on a grand trip to Paris and Greece. Three years later, the friend is sued for the cost of the trip and calls into question the statute of limitations.

videos.title: Rodents and Bedbugs and Hoarding..Oh My!
videos.overview: Senior roommates fight over who is to blame for the pain and suffering caused by their untenable living conditions. Health workers refuse homecare due to their unsanitary homelife.

videos.title: Teen Driver Meets Ex-Cop
videos.overview: In a mall parking lot, an unlicensed and uninsured teen driver backs into a retired police officer's car. She refuses to hand over any information at the scene and blames him for the accident.

videos.title: Not Seen on TV
videos.overview: While searching for love in Ukraine, an American man strikes up a friendship with an entrepreneur and invests $6500 to produce an adult reality TV show called "Daddy Knows Best". Swimsuit competitions and location scouting in the Dominican Republic leave the Judges questioning the investor's naivete and the producer's motivation.

videos.title: An Auction Gone Wrong
videos.overview: A woman entrusts $6,800 with a close friend who promises to purchase a car for her at an auction. When a car never materializes, she goes after her friend for payback.

videos.title: Covid Relief Payback
videos.overview: A tenant is accused of stealing Covid relief funds from her landlord. She admits to cashing a relief check intended for him but claims he'd already received aid and that her apartment was uninhabitable.

videos.title: Bailed-Out Boyfriend
videos.overview: A woman believes a terrible mistake has been made when marshals come to arrest her new boyfriend; she immediately bails him out only to discover fraud, forgery and another girlfriend.

videos.title: Testing the Limits of Southern Good Will
videos.overview: A Georgia man notices a laborer struggling with a move and offers him free use of his flatbed trailer. The laborer accepts his gracious offer only to overload the trailer, damage it and leaves it in a location where thieves strip it.

videos.title: Boat Buddy Bail Out
videos.overview: An elderly gentleman sells his boat to a young man and thinks he's found a good friend and new fishing buddy. The Judges question the 'friendship' when they uncover the details of a $5K bailout loan the young neighbor received from the man.

videos.title: Crypto Crash
videos.overview: A security guard says he was promised a 100% return on his $5K investment in cryptocurrency. Instead, his financial advisor says when the market crashed, so did all payout returns.

videos.title: Pit Bull Attacks Runner
videos.overview: After mauling a runner, a pit bull lunges at a police officer and is pepper sprayed. The pet owner insists his dogs are friendly and claims the runner provoked them.

videos.title: Obstruction of Justice Between Friends
videos.overview: A single mother exposes her own criminal activity when she decides to sue a friend for car repairs. Her friend also admits to being complicit in obstructing a police investigation.

videos.title: Party Bus Catastrophe
videos.overview: A night of celebration ends in disaster when the birthday girl and 25 of her closest friends are stranded at a winery in Malibu. She sues the party-bus owner for thousands spent on ride shares to get back home and for birthday gifts allegedly left on the bus.

videos.title: Woes of a First-Time Homeowner
videos.overview: A veteran makes several rookie mistakes when he purchases his first home and is sued for thousands by tenants that came with the property. A questionable inspection does little to back up his claims of property damage.

videos.title: Stolen Trailer and Cherished Ashes
videos.overview: A woman claims a former father figure in her life unlawfully withheld her truck and personal property. Accusations of theft and creepy behavior come into play as the woman makes an emotional attempt to retrieve her deceased friend’s ashes left in the truck.

videos.title: Dog Death by Delivery Driver
videos.overview: With the shocking incident captured on camera, a grief-stricken pet owner seeks $5K in compensation after her beloved dachshund is struck and killed by a food delivery driver. The apologetic defendant blames poor visibility and the dog running loose, leaving both parties in emotional turmoil and allegations of negligence looming large.

videos.title: Screenwriters' Covid Caper (Part 1)
videos.overview: In this two-part episode, screenwriter brothers face accusations of fraudulently attempting to obtain Covid relief in order to pay $20K in back rent. They deny all charges and cite endless harassment by their landlord who threatened to shut off their basic services.

videos.title: Screenwriters' Covid Caper (Part 2)
videos.overview: In part two, the Judges start to question the legitimacy of the brothers' Covid claim when they see a trail of text messages that may contradict their story. The landlord's willingness to provide a fake lease agreement so they could gain Covid relief to pay back rent also comes under scrutiny.

videos.title: Cat-Nipped
videos.overview: A woman sues for pain and suffering when her healthcare is disrupted by a landlord's refusal to return her security deposit. To make matters worse, the landlord is allegedly scratched in the face by her cat.

videos.title: Future Brother-in-Law and Order
videos.overview: A landlord faces off with his sister's fiance over eviction costs, property damage and alleged physical threats. The fiance not only denies any wrongdoing but accuses his future brother-in-law of stealing his property.

videos.title: Kitty Custody in an Open Relationship
videos.overview: After an unsuccessful attempt at an open relationship, a man sues his ex-girlfriend for unpaid rent, money lent, and custody of Willow, their shared pet cat. After the Judges' ruling, one of the litigants makes their final, tearful goodbye to Willow in the courtroom.

videos.title: Monkeypox Scare
videos.overview: A camp retreat for a men's group is cancelled due to a Monkeybox outbreak in California and a mudslide. Tears are shed when the owners of the beloved camp are sued for a refund.

videos.title: Pit Bulls on the Loose
videos.overview: A rescue pit bull described as gentle and well-behaved has to be beaten with a shovel to release a poodle from its mouth. The poodle's owner is also attacked and sues for $7K in medical bills and pain and suffering.

videos.title: Vending Machine Crash
videos.overview: An uber entrepreneur hires a mover to place her first vending machine in a commercial space. Understaffed and unprepared, the mover destroys her opportunity to make extra money when the machine promptly falls off his dolly.

videos.title: Waterslide Party Fail
videos.overview: A party-planning mom decides to go all-in and purchase a mega-waterslide for her annual family get-together. She winds up suing a business owner for $8K, claiming everything from delivery to set-up went wrong.

videos.title: Grandmother on the Attack
videos.overview: A woman sues her granddaughter for defamation and lying under oath, while the granddaughter claims she suffered emotional trauma from her elder’s actions. The Judges must navigate a complex, dramatic family history to uncover the truth and determine if this lawsuit is justified.

videos.title: Denturegate
videos.overview: A woman places blame for lost dentures on her toddler grandson and sues her son for thousands to replace them. The Judges question her decision to place her valuables in a bag of chips for safekeeping.

videos.title: Drip, Drip, Drought!
videos.overview: A landlord and tenant battle over skyrocketing water costs and garden upkeep during a drought. Pet violations and property damage come into play.

videos.title: Rocky Road Car Repair
videos.overview: A simple car repair turns into a 13-month enterprise when ex-friends fight over payment terms and a mysterious noise coming from underneath the hood.

videos.title: Crystals, Rocks and Sage Shutdown
videos.overview: Amid accusations of embezzlement, a lawsuit unfolds between two former business partners who were cited for running an apothecary business. The operational partner argues that the silent partner emptied the bank account and laid off employees without her knowledge.

videos.title: Once, Twice, Three Times a Roof
videos.overview: A woman accuses a veteran roofer of causing $14K in damages to her mobile home. He insists that the weight of an additional layer of shingles could never cause that much damage.

videos.title: Near-Fatal Highway Disaster
videos.overview: An uninsured driver going 70mph ploughs into a vehicle caught in a traffic standstill on the highway. A mother driving her son to college suffers extensive injuries when their car is flipped upon impact. The negligent driver denies being at fault.

videos.title: Not Heaven Sent
videos.overview: A woman in poor health believes her prayers have been answered when a neighbor steps up to help her with daily errands. Gratitude turns to suspicion when her money starts to go missing.

videos.title: Polyamorous Fail
videos.overview: A unique lifestyle choice leaves feuding ex-lovers, who have a child together, suing each other for the $10K court maximum over property damage as a result of an altercation and back rent.

videos.title: Buyer Beware
videos.overview: A man travels three hours to purchase his dream car only for it to break down 24 minutes into a test drive. The seller denies ever offering him a test drive and refuses to take back the vehicle.

videos.title: 40 'Again' Birthday Party Fail
videos.overview: When a 40th-birthday party is cancelled due to Covid, the birthday girl plans a grand do-over for her 41st. She sues for pain and suffering when the party venue's red walls clash with her gold color scheme.

videos.title: Dueling Police Arrests
videos.overview: After a humiliating arrest at gunpoint, a woman sues her own mother for $10K in pain and suffering for filing a false police report. The Judges reprimand both parties for using law enforcement to make gains against each other in a contentious family dispute.

videos.title: Welcome Back to the United States
videos.overview: After living in Mexico during the pandemic, a homeowner returns to the U.S. looking to buy out his tenants' lease and live in his own home again. Despite a substantial offer, he is met with a $10K lawsuit for moving fees and a security deposit.

videos.title: Hen House Mauling
videos.overview: Dogs escape their home and wreak lethal havoc on a neighbor's henhouse. The hobby farm owner is injured while trying to save her beloved hens; she sues for damages.

videos.title: Friendship Gone Foul
videos.overview: A woman provides a place to stay for a friend of 15 years but must take him to court to collect any rent. She claims he broke house rules and disrespected her boyfriend's sobriety when he brought alcohol into her home.

videos.title: Record Label Rip-Off
videos.overview: A failed music collaboration between longtime friends leads to accusations of theft, deception and misspent investments. A concert promoter alleges that the unauthorized release of the rap video jeopardizes the project's profitability for everyone involved and countersues the plaintiff for damages.

videos.title: Parking Spot Assault
videos.overview: A man claims his neighbor brutally attacked him and broke his leg in a fight over a parking spot; the Good Samaritan neighbor is detained by police after being accused of brandishing a gun.

videos.title: Polyamorous Debt
videos.overview: An aspiring teacher sues for the $10K court maximum after her boyfriend invites another person to join their open relationship. She discovers that money borrowed for his 'business trip' to Iowa was really being spent on his new love interest.

videos.title: From Big Brother to Broken Lease
videos.overview: A mentor-mentee relationship between roommates breaks down after a clash over chaotic living, a ‘visiting’ girlfriend, and a ‘surprise’ Rottweiler partial to gnawing on furniture.

videos.title: To Breed or Not To Breed
videos.overview: Tragedy strikes when a Great Dane gives birth to a litter of ten puppies and four of them die. The dog's owner cries medical negligence and sues a breeder for the $10K court maximum.

videos.title: New Tenant Shuffle
videos.overview: A woman comes home to find that her landlord has allegedly moved her belongings out and his new tenants in. She sues for double her security deposit.

videos.title: Vegas Baby!
videos.overview: A much-anticipated, all-girls trip between former classmates devolves into mudslinging and a lawsuit over trip costs. The plaintiff claims her goodwill 'blessings' to a friend were not meant to be taken literally.

videos.title: The Cycle Swindle
videos.overview: A motorcycle enthusiast from Spain hands over $6,000 for a Kawasaki only to discover that the seller never owned it. The Judges are appalled by the defendant's blatant disregard for the law.

videos.title: Toxic Romance
videos.overview: A young defendant storms out of the courtroom during a heated dispute with her ex-girlfriend over vet bills; she insists that payback was on its way until her personal property was held hostage.

videos.title: Police Misconduct or Paranoia?
videos.overview: In a heated battle over attorney fees and personal property, divorcees dispute child visitation, restraining orders and a distrust of small-town governance.

videos.title: Unauthorized Repair
videos.overview: A 94-year-old woman says her 'thieving contractor' messed with the wrong senior; she goes after him for thousands in unauthorized charges on her credit card.

videos.title: Snakes Are My Life!
videos.overview: A man's passionate hobby turns into a contentious battle with an ex-lover over a menagerie of 'pets' including 13 tarantulas, 6 ducks, 6 cats, 2 geckos and a hedgehog.

videos.title: Hot Wheels; Cold Deals
videos.overview: Divorcees rekindle their relationship and decide to live together again only to end up fighting over deluxe tire rims and wheels. A tragic death in the family and a bankruptcy further complicate the matter.

videos.title: Raising the Roof
videos.overview: An experienced roofer in Minnesota suspects he is a victim of fraud when an $8,000 insurance check goes into his clients' pockets instead of his own after he installs their brand new roof.

videos.title: Eviction Relocation Controversy
videos.overview: A landlord is sued for relocation fees after an allegedly illegal eviction. He claims his tenant is a con artist by demanding $30K to relocate.

videos.title: Contractor Under Fire: Part 1
videos.overview: In part one of this two-part episode, a contracting business is under fire when a married couple sues for shoddy work and unauthorized transactions. A satisfied customer speaks up in defense of the contractor's craft and character.

videos.title: Contractor Under Fire: Part 2
videos.overview: In part two, a woman sues the same contractor for improper and unfinished work, but the contractor claims he refunded her money and corrected the issue within days. Despite his efforts, she files a no-trespass order against him; the Judges question her motivation.

videos.title: Skate Park Controversy
videos.overview: A California skate park that once attracted world competitors goes out of business, leaving partners fighting over thousands left on an unpaid loan.

videos.title: Divorcee Demands Payback
videos.overview: After a 25-year-long relationship, an ex-wife sues her ex-husband for the court maximum of $10K in unpaid personal loans. She alleges that he repossessed a car behind her back, while he insists that he had no choice but to take it after his own car was stolen.

videos.title: Deal vs Damage
videos.overview: A landlord evicts long term tenants for reneging on their verbal agreement to maintain his property in exchange for low rent. He claims they left him with over $12K in property damage.

videos.title: Pay-It-Forward Scooter Tribute
videos.overview: A man strives to honor his parent's dying wish that their mobility scooters be shared with those in need; he sues for the return of one of the scooters claiming it was not gifted properly.

videos.title: Treat Him Like My Own Son
videos.overview: The Judges deliver an unprecedented ruling when a car deal is modified for the seller's unfair gain after payments had started. A woman is accused of taking advantage of a young man's good nature and unfortunate family circumstances.

videos.title: Vegas Birthday Disaster
videos.overview: When an all-girls birthday party gets physical, police are called to escort an intoxicated partygoer off the property. She demands payback for trip costs while the birthday girl countersues for a ruined 56th-birthday weekend.

videos.title: Renovation Nightmare
videos.overview: A debate over the quality of a home renovation devolves into mud-slinging by a handyman who blames the homeowner and her old house for any problems with his work.

videos.title: Parking Spot Squeeze
videos.overview: A man must crawl in and out of his SUV hatchback because his new apartment's parking spot is too tiny to exit his vehicle normally. He cites his landlord's misrepresentation of apartment amenities as one of the reasons he stopped paying rent.

videos.title: Woodchip Wrangling
videos.overview: A tree-cutting business owner sues for thousands in unpaid services after he cuts down timber and levels stumps. The customer, who refuses to pay, cites messy woodchips galore and the lack of an invoice.

videos.title: Pandemic Fail
videos.overview: A tenant receiving rental assistance during the pandemic says his landlord illegally raised the rent, violated his rights and bullied him off the property.

videos.title: Puppy Kidnapping or Abandonment?
videos.overview: A woman loans her friend money to buy a puppy but then holds the animal ransom until she is paid back; she claims her friend abandoned the animal.

videos.title: Wheeling and Dealing: Part 1
videos.overview: In part one of this two-part episode, a trucking company owner insists that his vehicle was in good condition before the defendant got his hands on it. The defendant says it was a piece of garbage with never-ending repair costs.

videos.title: Wheeling and Dealing: Part 2
videos.overview: In part two, the trucker demands thousands in lost wages for all the time he wasted haggling over a leased vehicle's repair. He claims all lost revenue would have been used to support his young son's dream of becoming an orthopaedic surgeon.

videos.title: Fridge Custody
videos.overview: A married couple buy a used refrigerator for $600. Angry that it doesn't work, they turn around and sue the seller for $1150 to fix it despite his offers to make things right.

videos.title: Contractor or Handyman?
videos.overview: A woman sues for thousands in pain and suffering when her contractor turns out to be a handyman with no license who refuses to refund her after a botched attempt at asbestos removal.

videos.title: Pet Death Trauma
videos.overview: A teacup Yorkie is mauled by a larger dog and dies in its owner's arms. Pet owners fight over liability, the cost of pain and suffering and cremation costs.

videos.title: The Trailer Nobody Wanted
videos.overview: A 46-year-old trailer sold for $2500 sparks a legal battle as the buyer claims the seller misrepresented its condition and defrauded him. The Judges must decide whether a refund is owed or if the buyer should have known better than to believe the seller's assurances.

videos.title: Car Wars
videos.overview: The Judges discover a critical error in a mechanic's defense against thousands allegedly owed to a client who claims he held her car hostage.

videos.title: Live-In Carpenter
videos.overview: A unique working relationship between a carpenter and client devolves into a fight over tools, rent and the personal nature of their business arrangement.

videos.title: Ex Friends Wage War
videos.overview: In this two-part episode, a woman sues for loan payback and thousands in emotional distress after her ex-friend refuses to testify on her behalf in a contentious protective order hearing.

videos.title: Dangerous Living
videos.overview: An extreme fixer upper in Minnesota is the subject of a heated debate over a tenant's liability for damages. A tour of the $55K house, formerly owned by the sheriff, reveals over $100K in basement damages, frozen pipes and pet waste.

videos.title: Where's the Beef?
videos.overview: Muchacho, a Black Angus cow, is slaughtered and a portion is sold to a contractor for $2500. The seller claims the contractor was unhappy with his cut of the meat; the contractor says his half of the cow was never delivered.

videos.title: The Cost of Disrepair
videos.overview: A mother of three denies owing a penny to her landlord due to a hazardous living environment citing a non-working bathroom, holes in the floor, and poor air quality. The landlord disputes many of her claims but admits some problems were present when her family moved in.

videos.title: She Owes Me Bail Money!
videos.overview: Despite making violent threats in the presence of police, a woman sues for the emotional distress of a 'false' arrest and for bail money. A 'lucky' legal technicality and footage of her outrageous behavior come into play.

videos.title: Dueling Tragedies
videos.overview: Custom work on a 1969 Mustang for a man's wife takes so long that he is divorced by the time of its near completion. Detailing on the classic car is further complicated by the tragic death of the mechanic's son.

videos.title: Mobile Home Tug-of-War
videos.overview: A disgruntled tenant seeks the $10K court maximum, accusing her landlord of reneging on a deal to sell her mobile home. Allegedly falsified documents and an illegal eviction come into play.

videos.title: Ill-Fated Dining Choice
videos.overview: After a girls' night out, friends discover that they parked illegally. A woman sues for the aggravation of not being paid back fast enough for towing fees and for a $79 pair of shoes.

videos.title: Fight to the Finish
videos.overview: Two childhood friends, a former pro-boxer turned entrepreneur and a graphic designer, accuse each other of business sabotage, betrayal, and unpaid rent as they fight over $13K. Tensions run high requiring intervention from both of the bailiffs.

videos.title: Off-Roading Truck Neglect
videos.overview: An off-roading enthusiast takes his Chevy Bronco in for repairs and soon discovers that he is not a priority for the mechanic. After a year of text message excuses, he takes action and seeks justice.

videos.title: Puppy Death Investigation
videos.overview: An emotional support puppy dies after only three days with its new owner. A veteran Yorkie-Maltese breeder and the pet's owner fight over proper care and feeding of this delicate pet.

videos.title: Accomplice Mechanic
videos.overview: What starts as a simple repair job on a 20-year-old truck ends with a mechanic's refusal to accept an allegedly stolen engine to use for parts from his non-paying customer.

videos.title: Classic Car Catastrophe
videos.overview: A woman's dreams of seeing her 1977 Pontiac Firebird restored to perfection are dashed when it is allegedly painted the wrong color and the upholstery is destroyed.

videos.title: Mental Health Crossfire
videos.overview: The $10,000 court maximum is at stake as a woman alleges emotional distress from a botched bathroom remodel. She accuses her contractor of being on a St. Patrick's Day party bus instead of in the hospital, as he claimed.

videos.title: Cruise Catastrophe
videos.overview: Former friends fight over a vacation to the Bahamas, threatening texts, and a stolen car. The defendant seeks the court maximum compensation for alleged emotional distress and defamation.

videos.title: Hit-and-Run Conspiracy Theory
videos.overview: Thousands in repairs are at stake when a woman sues an ex-friend over an alleged hit-and-run in her car. The case takes a shocking turn as the Judges uncover evidence suggesting that both parties might be involved in insurance fraud and lying to the police.

videos.title: Dementia Dilemma
videos.overview: A woman sues her husband's personal trainer for overcharging; the trainer counters with car damage claims due to her husband's dementia-related mobility issues. Controversial 'staged' videos are submitted as evidence.

videos.title: Jewelry Legacy Battle
videos.overview: A massage therapist takes her ex-friend to court for losing her mother's heirloom ring during a repair job, leaving her with a $1K replacement bill.

videos.title: Prison Wedding Fail
videos.overview: From a jailhouse wedding to a courtroom clash, an ex-husband accuses his ex-wife of vandalizing his car. She claims any number of women could be responsible.

videos.title: Slot Machine Gamble
videos.overview: A disabled retiree sues her former friend over $9,000 allegedly given for slot machines to open a game room together. The friend claims they were both scammed.

videos.title: Friendship Collision Course
videos.overview: A woman sues her former best friend for damaging her car in an altercation with her boyfriend's 'girlfriend'. The defendant storms out of the courtroom when questioned about the incident.

videos.title: Damage Discrepancy
videos.overview: A married couple sues their former tenant, claiming damages exceeding $80K to their rental property. The defendant believes the damages are exaggerated to finance the couple's home renovations and countersues for the return of her security deposit.

videos.title: Glamour Gone Wrong
videos.overview: A $10K courtroom battle ensues as a woman sues her cosmetologist over a disastrous birthday facial and hair weave, alleging blistered lips and a scalp stabbing. The cosmetologist countersues, citing emotional distress and a canceled wedding.

videos.title: California Rent Rumble
videos.overview: A Florida couple with a newborn sues their California landlord, who aids homeless families, alleging overcrowding and financial mistreatment. The landlord countersues, accusing them of forgery and harassment.

videos.title: Brain Surgery Setback
videos.overview: When a woman demands payback from her cousin for a car, he cites brain surgery and her attitude as the reasons for non-payment.

videos.title: Vintage Boutique Wars - Part 1
videos.overview: In part one of this two-part episode, an ex-boyfriend asserts partnership rights to a vintage boutique while his ex-girlfriend, backed by a restraining order against him, denies his claims.

videos.title: Vintage Boutique Wars - Part 2
videos.overview: In part two of this contentious vintage boutique dispute, a video surfaces depicting a heated exchange during a custody handoff.

videos.title: A Grandmother's Deadly Defense
videos.overview: A family dispute over a deceased relative's car escalates into a police pursuit triggering a dangerous chain of events.

videos.title: Battle of the Backhoe
videos.overview: A veteran insists on a $7,500 refund for a faulty backhoe purchased to launch his small business, alleging he was deceived by the seller.

videos.title: Mic Drop Meltdown
videos.overview: Performer 'Queen Rita' sues her booker for the $10K court maximum, alleging she was scammed into paying for a fake radio station gig. The booker claims innocence, citing his own victimization by a mysterious scam artist.

videos.title: From Friends to Foes
videos.overview: Two decades of friendship unravel over a bitter money dispute as a woman, reeling from her husband's death, feels betrayed after lending her former best friend $5,000. She demands payback, highlighting her ex-friend's lavish vacations in contrast to her own financial struggles.

videos.title: The Grass Isn't Greener
videos.overview: A couple's dream of a lush backyard turns into a legal battleground as they sue a contractor for allegedly botching their irrigation system, leading to flooding and dead sod. The contractor countersues, claiming defamation over negative reviews.

videos.title: Mold Mayhem
videos.overview: A woman sues a man for damages caused by his dogs in her rented home; he denies responsibility, calling it a money grab. An expert witness and suspicions about prior property damage come into play.

videos.title: Service Horse Woes
videos.overview: A woman sues her ex-landlord, alleging negligence that caused her service horse, Ruby, to injure her leg on nails sticking out of a stable door. The landlord countersues, citing lease violations and pointing to a signed release of liability.

videos.title: Tenant Landlord Showdown - Part 1
videos.overview: In part one of this two-part episode, a blue-collar father of three reaches his breaking point, accusing his landlord of relentless and unfair billing practices. The landlord, in turn, demands compensation for the inconvenience caused by the legal action.

videos.title: Tenant Landlord Showdown - Part 2
videos.overview: In part two of this two-part episode, evidence of the father's threatening texts, leading to the landlord obtaining a restraining order, comes into play. The father's explosive reaction prompts both bailiffs to intervene.

videos.title: Twin Sister Roommate Nightmare
videos.overview: An attempt by twin sisters to live together backfires as they battle over rent, food-theft surveillance, and a sorority sweater.

videos.title: Past Debts, Present Grudges
videos.overview: A man sues his ex-girlfriend for brake repair costs, doubling the amount due to perceived malice. She says they are even because she supported him during his incarceration.

videos.title: Dirt Bike Surprise Heist
videos.overview: A man is taken by surprise when attempting to resell a bike, as the rightful owners assert it was stolen and show up to reclaim it. The defendant argues the bike was a legitimate gift from his girlfriend.

videos.title: The Flooded and the Furious
videos.overview: With the $10,000 court limit on the line, an aunt sues her live-in nephew, claiming he left her drowning in debt due to his negligence. He accuses her of drugging his dog and illegally subletting.

videos.title: Sibling Betrayal
videos.overview: In a family feud over finances, a brother sues his younger sister for defaulting on a car loan and wrecking the vehicle. He is left with a hefty bill and her tearful apologies.

videos.title: Basketball Legends Showdown
videos.overview: A basketball enthusiast sues a collector after selling a set of iconic cards, including legends Michael Jordan and Kobe Bryant, for $56K, only to find the check canceled.

videos.title: Secret Sublet Battle
videos.overview: A man accuses his ex-roommate of illegal subletting and seeks the return of his security deposit; she retaliates with allegations of property damage through bleaching.

videos.title: Teenage High-Speed Chase
videos.overview: A graduation roadtrip spirals into a chaotic drug-fueled crime spree, leading to a legal battle between two teenage girls. Conflicting stories involve a DWI, marijuana possession, an intentional deer collision, and a gripping two-hour high-speed police chase across four counties.

videos.title: Dehydration Made Me Do It!
videos.overview: A neighbor takes legal action when his outdoor water spigot is vandalized by his neighbor's young grandsons and their friend. The grandsons, ages 10 and 12, take the stand and are faced with a pivotal choice.

videos.title: Cinderella Man
videos.overview: A 29-year-old man, who was adopted from foster care as a child, takes legal action against his estranged aunt, seeking $10,000 in damages for wrongful eviction and property damage. He claims family dynamics were strained after the death of the woman who adopted him, leading to alleged mistreatment in the years that followed.

videos.title: From Fiancés to Foes
videos.overview: A 63-year-old man sues his ex-fiancée for $10,000, claiming she owes him for an engagement ring. Despite her defense of sentimental value, he argues she should repay him, especially given her quick rebound into marriage with another man.

videos.title: $20,000 Collision
videos.overview: A mother and son seek $20K in damages after a woman rolls through a stop light and crashes their Tesla.

videos.title: Class Action Greenhouse Failure
videos.overview: In a multi-state class action, two couples sue a South Carolina builder for taking their money but not finishing their greenhouse projects. The builder argues they ended the contracts too soon, while the couples accuse him of outright fraud.

videos.title: Fever Pitch Parking Fury
videos.overview: In a heated dispute over an unassigned parking spot, a woman sues her neighbor for damaging her front door, escalating tensions to the point of a restraining order.

videos.title: Super Senior Eviction
videos.overview: The $10K court maximum is at stake when an 82-year-old retired teacher battles his handyman-turned-tenant over unpaid rent and incomplete renovations.

videos.title: Grandma's $10K Challenge - Part 1
videos.overview: In part one of this two-part case, a woman pursues legal action against her teen granddaughter and her boyfriend, seeking the $10K court maximum for unpaid rent and expenses.

videos.title: Grandma's $10K Challenge - Part 2
videos.overview: In part two, despite the grandmother's efforts to keep her grandchildren out of foster care, her granddaughter involves the police and denies owing anything.

videos.title: Spar Over a Classic Car
videos.overview: A classic car enthusiast sues her friend for $10K after a failed restoration of her dream 1952 Desoto. He argues that her tight budget and short timeline were unrealistic.

videos.title: Model Plane Scam
videos.overview: A retired machinist sues his ex-tenant for losses in a model plane venture, alleging a promised $35,000 profit on a $3,500 investment. The defendant cites challenges in selling planes to Florida's 'snowbird' audience.

videos.title: Gas-and-Go Betrayal
videos.overview: A 33-year-old woman sues her childhood friend for $2,500 over a car sale after her husband passed away. The defendant is linked to a gas-and-go theft caught on camera, a revoked license, and a police stop regarding her children's safety.

videos.title: Bug Phobia Face-Off
videos.overview: A working student challenges her ex-landlord, alleging that her new studio apartment was a bug-infested nightmare. Armed with real-time texts, she demands a full refund, but the landlord fires back, accusing her of making it all up to ditch the lease.

videos.title: Incarceration Impact
videos.overview: A young woman sues her mother for over $5K in loans, exposing the mother's pattern of funneling the money to her unemployed, ex-convict son. The mother argues that her son's criminal record hinders his job prospects and points to money she spent in the past to raise her daughter.

videos.title: The Bounty Hunter
videos.overview: A bounty hunter from Indiana sues a woman for recovery costs after her husband, deemed armed and dangerous, evades court. Denying harboring the fugitive, she accuses the bounty hunter of traumatizing her children during armed confrontations.

videos.title: Builder Blunder
videos.overview: A woman sues her kitchen remodel subcontractor for $10,000 after alleging shoddy work and an unlicensed practice.

videos.title: Hit Me With Your Best Cart
videos.overview: A woman files for $5K in damages when her neighbor's 15-year-old son takes an unauthorized joyride in a golf cart and slams into her car.

videos.title: Stress in the Stables - Part 1
videos.overview: In part one of this two-part episode, a woman demands payment for equestrian event fees, disputed due to a child's illness and a contested doctor's note.

videos.title: Stress in the Stables - Part 2
videos.overview: In part two, tensions rise as the young rider's mother countersues over a $1,200 horse saddle sale, leading to tears and escalating conflict.

videos.title: Dog Grooming Anxiety and Injury
videos.overview: A woman is suing a dog groomer for $5K, claiming negligence in injuring her pet. The groomer claims she neglected to disclose her dog's behavioral issues.

videos.title: That's What Friends Are Not For
videos.overview: A dispute arises between a man and a cleaning company owner regarding a poorly executed deep clean of his rental house, prompting a demand for a refund. Despite incriminating photos, the owner, who was once friends with the client, argues that she went above and beyond to help him.

videos.title: Donuts, DUIs & Damages
videos.overview: A teenage, alcohol-fueled party spirals into a legal battle when a "Fast and Furious" inspired stunt leaves one friend's car totaled and the other behind bars. The defendant, accused of framing her friend for the accident, denies any liability.

videos.title: COVID Resort Rift
videos.overview: A restauranteur sues a Palm Desert resort owner for the court maximum, alleging he used her employees to secure $27K in Covid-relief loans.

videos.title: Wear and Tear Warfare
videos.overview: A Kansas City landlord sues a former friend for breaking a lease and causing extensive damage to his property. He claims to have compelling video evidence that reveals a shocking state of disarray.

videos.title: Sugarless Sugar Daddy
videos.overview: A woman sues her ex-sugar daddy for unpaid loans, though he claims they're even after giving her over $17K. His estranged wife, child visitation, and firearm issues further complicate the situation.

videos.title: Odometer Felony Fraud
videos.overview: With the $10K court maximum at stake, business partners face allegations of selling a defective car with tampered mileage.

videos.title: Baby Safety at Stake
videos.overview: A woman takes her former friend and contractor to court, asserting that the deck he revamped was not just incomplete but posed a safety risk to her 16-month-old baby. The contractor defends his work, citing budget constraints and insisting it was safe enough for his own five kids.

videos.title: Luxury Cleaning Clash
videos.overview: A Palm Springs cleaning business owner sues her luxury apartment rental client for $3,000, alleging non-payment and termination without cause.

videos.title: Handyman Havoc
videos.overview: A Marine Corps gunner and his wife sue their former handyman for negligence and incomplete work; the handyman countersues for defamation.

videos.title: Lake Arrowhead Legal Showdown
videos.overview: A woman accuses her landlord of discarding over $4K worth of her personal belongings; he countersues for damages, alleging extortion and fake liens.

videos.title: Weight Loss Gone Wrong
videos.overview: A veteran nutritionist takes legal action against a client who stopped payment for her contracted weight loss services. The client fights back citing claims of body shaming and a pre-existing medical condition.

videos.title: Racially-Charged Bulldog Dispute
videos.overview: A dog breeder takes extreme measures to intimidate the defendant in a battle to recover payment for a French Bulldog. Shocking audio recordings expose a fabricated police threat and disturbing racist outbursts.

videos.title: Childcare Goodbyes and Covid Lies
videos.overview: A single mom faces a lawsuit from her child's daycare owner over unpaid fees, sparking a heated clash where accusations of lying about COVID tests add fuel to the fire.

videos.title: Million-Dollar Braiding Upset
videos.overview: An aspiring high-end realtor alleges she missed out on a million-dollar listing due to a botched braiding job. A young stylist defends her work but ceases all braiding due to stress caused by the incident.

videos.title: Inheritance Intrigue
videos.overview: A Minnesota woman sues her ex-husband over a $43,000 boat loan co-signed by her late mother for his competitive fishing. He claims the debt was forgiven before her mother's death.

videos.title: Cross-Border Lemon
videos.overview: A woman sues a used car salesman over the purchase of a lemon car. She argues she couldn't inspect it due to a once-in-a-lifetime trip to see her mother in Mexico.

videos.title: Slip of Grip
videos.overview: A move from Florida to Alabama is fraught with mishaps from a sweaty-hands couch drop to a washer's alleged bounce down a flight of stairs. A couple sues for damage to their property while a seasoned mover challenges their claims of negligence.

videos.title: Parking Space Panic
videos.overview: A delivery driver alleges a man totaled her SUV by slamming into it as he exited a parking space. He says he only agreed to pay for her damages because he was frightened and uninsured.

videos.title: Atlanta Filmmaker vs Goodwill Grocer
videos.overview: An Atlanta-based filmmaker seeks damages following a tumultuous shoot marred by empty shelves, a missing bathroom, and the unexpected presence of livestock. The non-profit grocery owner asserts that he had no obligation to read the filmmaker's script or prepare the store for her shoot.

videos.title: Nerf Gun E-Bike Collision
videos.overview: A California couple files a lawsuit against a woman for damages caused by her 14-year-old son, who crashed into their garage door while riding an electric bike.

videos.title: When Trees Attack!
videos.overview: A homeowner faces off against her engineer neighbors in a dispute over a storm-damaged fence, courtesy of trees from their property.

videos.title: Dating App Vendetta
videos.overview: An ex-girlfriend admits to creating a fake dating profile to track her boyfriend in this $10K lawsuit over personal property.

videos.title: From Rent to Rage
videos.overview: In a $10K court showdown, a couple squares off against their tenants for damages and are met with a countersuit for invasion of privacy and harassment. Their handyman files a separate lawsuit for assault, backed by surveillance footage of several harrowing incidents.

videos.title: Wedding Vow, No CHOW!
videos.overview: Wedding disaster strikes when a caterer is a no-show leaving newlyweds and guests without food and sparking a social media feud.

videos.title: Golden Girls Collection Agency
videos.overview: In a neighborhood spat, a widow sues her neighbor for unpaid loans her deceased husband provided. She sets the record straight, emphasizing there was no romantic involvement between them.

videos.title: Betrayal Behind Bars
videos.overview: A veteran sues his ex-girlfriend for $10K in stolen money and property claiming she spent his bail money on herself while he sat in jail on drug charges.

videos.title: American Pit Bull Horror Story
videos.overview: In the wake of a devastating dog attack in Texas, a woman seeks $10K in damages after her Yorkie is torn from her arms and killed. The pit bulls' owner must make a difficult decision regarding the fate of his aggressive animals.

videos.title: Caretaker's Reckoning
videos.overview: A blind man sues his former caretaker, claiming breach of agreement for living rent-free in exchange for services. The caretaker alleges abuse.

videos.title: Auto Alimony
videos.overview: In a $10,000 lawsuit, a woman takes legal action against her ex-husband claiming he promised to split the cost of a vehicle for their eldest son.

videos.title: The Tesla Hot Mess-la
videos.overview: A night of clubbing ends in a Tesla crash and a $6,000 lawsuit where a woman blames her friend for grabbing the wheel and causing her to crash into a pole. Her claim of sober driving starts to unravel when a shocking video surfaces in court.

videos.title: Whose Bike is it Anyway?
videos.overview: A messy breakup leaves ex-lovers fighting over a child's bike; she claims it was a gift for her son, while he insists it belonged to his daughter. The dispute sparks restraining orders and smashed property.

videos.title: Stay For Free, Got My Degree
videos.overview: A cash-strapped USC business student claims his L.A. rental was so cold and moldy it made him sick. The landlord says he ignored the lease, filed secret complaints and still had energy for a backpacking trip.

videos.title: Sugar Daddy's Love Sick Loan
videos.overview: After meeting on a sugar daddy website, a man says he spent up to $20,000 on a woman, but draws the line at a $600 rent loan she promised to repay. She insists it was just part of the deal but he sends her more money the morning of court.

videos.title: "Paws Up" Don't Shoot
videos.overview: A charging pit bull is shot by police after brutally mauling a woman just steps from her car. She's demanding $10K for medical bills and trauma, backed by graphic video and photos. The dog's owners claim her bills are inflated.

videos.title: Ripped Off Ride (1)
videos.overview: In part one of this case, a used truck advertised with no problems turns out to be a total lemon, triggering a $10K fraud claim against its teenage seller.

videos.title: Ripped Off Ride (2)
videos.overview: Surprise mechanic testimony reveals the teen ignored major repairs. She denies accusations of tampering with over 200,000 miles on the odometer.

videos.title: Italian-Flavored Bad Behavior
videos.overview: An opera impresario demands $10K back from the LA Italian Festival, claiming they misused his sponsorship funds. His wife, a professional soprano, delivers a live performance during the court proceedings.

videos.title: Promises, Palimony and Police
videos.overview: After cheating ended their 16-year relationship, a man says he was forced to sign a breakup contract promising to pay his ex's rent in exchange for his freedom. They're locked in a $10K legal battle over unregistered firearms, missing property and her not-so-subtle war with his new girlfriend.

videos.title: Fowl Play
videos.overview: An Air Force veteran with PTSD raised hens as emotional support animals until two neighbourhood dogs escaped and killed ten of them in a violent attack caught on video. Now he's suing the dog owner and property owner for $10K.

videos.title: Racist Road Rage Wreck
videos.overview: Tense bodycam footage and a dramatic 911 call capture the chaotic aftermath of a road rage crash. One driver is arrested after hurling racial slurs. The other makes an aggressive lane change and claims assault.

videos.title: Hurricane-Saw Tree Massacre
videos.overview: A fallen palm tree with sentimental roots sparks a $5,000 courtroom feud between longtime Florida neighbours. One side calls it trespassing and trauma, the other calls it hazardous hurricane cleanup.

videos.title: Courtroom Clash Between Counsel & Client
videos.overview: An attorney sues a longtime client for unpaid fees after rushing to help her with an eviction case. She calls it a favor but melts down in court when the bill comes due.

videos.title: Scamming 101
videos.overview: An 18-year-old sues his former middle school friend for $1,400 over two sets of tires bought through a sketchy social media account. The defendant says he sold the account and walked away but shocking video evidence links him to a past credit card scam.

videos.title: The Bat and the Backlash
videos.overview: After trying to silence her name-calling neighbour with a baseball bat, a woman is swiftly arrested. She takes him to court and suing for emotional distress, property damage and the cost of her bail.

videos.title: Driving a Wedge Between Family
videos.overview: A teen sues her aunt for keeping over $6,000 from a car refinance she says was rightfully hers. The aunt fires back, claiming she's owed the full court max for years of food, clothing and care while the teen's mother was in prison.

videos.title: Crypto Chiro's Downward Spiral
videos.overview: In this episode, the Judges hear two shocking cases involving the same chiropractor.  First, a woman sues her longtime doctor for misusing her $10,000 loan to feed a hidden gambling addiction - an addiction he admits drove him to take money from 25 patients.  Then, another former patient claims he was tricked into "investing" thousands and now wants his money back.

videos.title: The Wall Came Tumbling Down
videos.overview: A crumbling wall sets off a feud between neighbors after one catches the other's crew tearing it down and runs to the police. What follows is a clash over trespassing, messy boundaries and whether it was a safety fix or just bad neighbor behavior.

videos.title: Family Ties, Trips & Lies
videos.overview: A luxury family trip to Italy turns into a $10K lawsuit when a woman sues a family member for backing out last-minute and skipping payments on a car she helped finance. He alleges that unspoken rifts over identity, not just money, are driving the dispute.

videos.title: Misdialed and Messed up Manual Labor
videos.overview: An unlicensed contractor fails in his attempt to pour a level cement patio and is sued for $6k when water leaks into his client's basement. He says there were major drainage issues long before he arrived on the scene.

videos.title: The $5,000 Tip Trick
videos.overview: After a night of wings and pickle-back shots, a customer leaves a $5,000 tip on a $23 bar tab, only to reverse it the next day claiming he meant to leave $50. The bar owner sues for the loss, while a surprise witness says the big gesture was no accident.

videos.title: You Kidnapped My Son! (Part 1)
videos.overview: In part one of this explosive two-part case, a frantic couple accuse a woman of kidnapping their 15-year-old son claiming she hid him for months and lead them to hire a private investigator to bring him home.

videos.title: You Kidnapped My Son! (Part 2)
videos.overview: In part two, the woman strikes back with a $10K countersuit, insisting she was protecting the teen from abuse and emotional neglect. She says the parents' public accusations destroyed her reputation and mental health.

videos.title: Cabinet Catastrophe
videos.overview: A couple hired a charming handyman they met at a bar, but when he failed to finish their job, excuses fly, tensions rise, and blame shifts from faulty tools to the wife's attitude.

videos.title: From Friends to Frenemies
videos.overview: A 30-year friendship blows up after a canceled music festival in the Dominican Republic ends in accusations of stolen cash used for gambling, unpaid debts and being ghosted during a cancer diagnosis.

videos.title: Bone Appetit!
videos.overview: When a rescue dog bites a woman, severely injuring her, its distraught owner claims the victim is at fault, sparking a contentious legal battle.

videos.title: Wedding Not Planned
videos.overview: An engaged couple sues their wedding planners for double charges and unpaid vendors just weeks before their big day. The planner fires back with a $10K countersuit over fraud claims, a slur and a dramatic courtroom walkout.

videos.title: The Last Ride
videos.overview: After a ten-year relationship ends, a man sues his ex for half of their car and insists that he only put the vehicle in her name to protect his large inheritance from liability claims.

videos.title: Lawnmower Sibling Spat
videos.overview: A "cancer-stricken" brother says his sister's husband pulled a gun during a fight over a lawnmower he pawned for meds. She says he faked the illness and still owes her money.

videos.title: Good Deed or Bad Roommate?
videos.overview: A mother sues her daughter's ex-boyfriend for $10K in rent and utilities after their messy household split. He insists he co-signed out of love, paid more than his share and was effectively pushed out of a home he helped secure.

videos.title: Seeking Wreck-Ognition
videos.overview: A woman hits her neighbor's parked car, sparking a no-insurance dispute that erupts in court. The driver is thrown out twice and the plaintiff is accused of lying to police.

videos.title: Breakup Before the Boarding Pass
videos.overview: They met at a dog park, survived brain illness, breakups and planned a dream cruise, until a solo Vegas trip ended everything. Now she's suing for the trip refund, while he countersues for back rent, emotional distress and invasion of privacy.

videos.title: Deck Debacle
videos.overview: After a freak hailstorm delays a renovation project, a homeowner sues his contractor for ghosting him mid-job. The contractor says he thought he was fired and moved on.

videos.title: Throwing Stones In A Glass House
videos.overview: A shocking video shows a woman hurling bricks at her neighbor's car. She claims the real threat came from the neighbor who later jumped her with her adult daughter in a violent assault.

videos.title: Feline Fraud and a Cat Fight
videos.overview: A nurse buys a Persian kitten from an 18-year-old, only to discover the vet records were incomplete and that the cat was sick, spreading infection to her household. She sues for $5K, while the teen, who filed a police report offer the dispute, denies wrongdoing and countersues for $10K.

videos.title: Love Don't Live Here Anymore
videos.overview: A grieving girlfriend fronts cash to spring her boyfriend's car out of repo and expects to be paid back. After physical assaults, career resentment and a messy breakup, he says the deal's off and he owes her nothing.

videos.title: Renovations, Repairs and Regrets!
videos.overview: A powerhouse real estate agent sues for the $10K court max after investing in upgrades to sell a grieving senior's property, only to be accused of elder abuse and compensation when the home was relisted at a higher price.

videos.title: Party Bus Bites the Dust
videos.overview: A once-beloved party bus allegedly turned cat sanctuary gets sold as junk, sparking a $5,000 feud between a nephew and his uncle, who says it held years of memories with his late sister.

videos.title: Family Feud
videos.overview: A family getaway to Croatia unravels into a $10K lawsuit after a blow-up leads to canceled return flights, rental car chaos and three women stranded overseas.

videos.title: Cell-Mate
videos.overview: After two weeks of living together, a woman reports that her new friend damaged her property and left a cell phone bill unpaid. He states that he was struggling with addiction and grief, denies causing the damage and says he paid his share.

videos.title: Dude, Where's My Bike?
videos.overview: A missing superbike and a year of silence lead a motorcycle club rider to sue a mechanic for $10k. An expert witness and champion racer Parker Pitman weighs in on the bike's real value and condition.

videos.title: Eddie Limousine Thinks Your Post Is Mean
videos.overview: A limo company owner and former chauffeur to Donald Trump, sues a Facebook group moderator for $5K, claiming viral false posts accusing him of drunk driving ruined his reputation and cost him business.

videos.title: Cruise, Booze and Payment Dues
videos.overview: After reconnecting at a funeral, two women who were once like family, take a Caribbean cruise together but only one of them pays for it. Now she's suing for $5,000, while the other says she was pressured, misled and already paid more than she owed.

videos.title: Lease Swap
videos.overview: A couple's urgent move out of state to find work leads to a lease swap with a former coworker who now refuses to pay. She accuses the couple of pressuring her to sign a costly contract.

videos.title: It's a Bin-Zebo
videos.overview: A couple pays $800 at a yard sale for a massive bin to build a DIY backyard "Bin-Zebo," but the seller never delivers. After delays, ignored texts and a political jab about the election, they're suing for the bin or their money back.

videos.title: Where's My Dough?
videos.overview: After 24 years, a former pizza manager is sued by the chain's founder for unpaid fees and taxes, but he argues the inherited debt and a COVID closure mean he owes nothing for a failed deal.

videos.title: Exes, Accusations and a House
videos.overview: Fearing his daughter would be taken out of state, a father says he loaned his ex thousands to help her buy a house and stay nearby. She says the money was a gift and countersues for $10K, accusing him of spreading lies with a false CPS report.

videos.title: Deserted in the Desert
videos.overview: An elderly woman gives a handyman $750 to help her move across California, but after two no-shows and radio silence, she had to hire someone else. Now she's demanding her money back, while he says she was never charged.

videos.title: Peeved Over Pet Damage
videos.overview: A landlord sues her former tenant, alleging his dog caused extensive urine damage to newly installed luxury flooring. He fires back, claiming the floors were already flawed. An expert witness weighs in.

videos.title: Lights, Camera, Lawsuit!
videos.overview: The creator of a YouTube talk show sues a media consultant for $5,800, claiming he failed to deliver on his promises. He argues that she took full advantage of his services and only asked for a refund after her merchandise was stolen and her budget fell apart.

videos.title: Turdnado: Part 1
videos.overview: In part one of this high-stakes two-part case, a couple sues the retired sellers of their dream home for $10K, claiming a hidden sewer disaster flooded their basement and was fraudulently concealed.

videos.title: Turdnado: Part 2
videos.overview: In part two, a surprise witness, the original plumber, takes the stand with evidence of a major obstruction the seller allegedly left out of the paperwork, raising questions about their transparency and intent.

videos.title: The Weave Deceives
videos.overview: Aunt and niece face off in court after a weave goes wrong, with the aunt demanding $755 for bad hair, stress and a new stylist. The niece says the problem wasn't her work but the low-grade hair her aunt purchased and all the drama that came with it.

videos.title: Pop Goes the Easel
videos.overview: An art entrepreneur launches a paint-and-sip pop-up inside a secondhand store but when rent goes unpaid, the store owner sues for $6,250 over lost income. The artist blames strict rules, surveillance and no bathroom access for killing her business.

videos.title: Dump Truck Disaster
videos.overview: A new homeowner hires a gravel man to fix her driveway, only to end up in court when he knocks down her power lines and sparks an explosion.

videos.title: Love Hurts!
videos.overview: After spotting a diamond ring on the ground, two longtime friends disagree on what happened next. He says he trusted her to appraise it, while she says it was a gift. Now he's suing for $10K.

videos.title: No Leg to Stand On
videos.overview: After losing 100 pounds and surviving a mini-stroke, a man orders a one-of-a-kind table to celebrate. But when the finish isn't perfect, he allegedly breaks into the store, takes the piece from the workshop and now faces an $8,000 lawsuit for theft and damages.

videos.title: Bad Breeding
videos.overview: A buyer's grief turns to legal action after her Doberman puppy is euthanized, claiming the breeder concealed a fatal illness, igniting a contentious dispute over a "no-refund" contract. The breeder countersues for elder abuse and emotional distress.

videos.title: Not So Hot Tub
videos.overview: A backyard hot tub turns into a $10K battle after a therapist claims the unlicensed builder botched the job, broke the warranty and kept asking for extra money to buy land in El Salvador.

videos.title: Oops!... I Pawned It Again
videos.overview: A woman facing financial hardship breaks down in court after losing two sentimental rings to a pawn shop. She calls the police claiming she was blocked from buying them back, while the owner says she just didn't pay.

videos.title: Wax On, Wax Off
videos.overview: A $7 lip wax sparks a $10 lawsuit, down from the $230,000 originally demanded. A botched salon visit allegedly left an aesthetician with 2nd degree burns and unable to work a high-paying beauty industry job.

videos.title: Mini-Mall Meltdown
videos.overview: After a messy breakup with her mini-mall tenant, a woman sues for nearly $9,000 while the tenant claims she was constructively evicted by the plaintiff's husband and handed a master key that opened her neighbor's shop.

videos.title: The Mechanic, the Lover and the Lawsuit
videos.overview: A woman takes in her longtime mechanic during his separation but after a short-lived romance, she sues him for unpaid bills and missing belongings. He says it was all a gift.

videos.title: Grave Mistake: The Case of the Casket Graffiti
videos.overview: A funeral turns into a family feud when a woman sues her cousins for defacing their beloved grandmother's coffin. They claim she hijacked the service leaving them no choice but to say goodbye their own way.

videos.title: Rent's Due and the Friendship's Through
videos.overview: A lease dispute between childhood best friends turns personal over a drunken New Year's Eve altercation, a missed funeral and a text to one of their moms that crossed the line.

videos.title: Rent Deposit Return Burn Part 1
videos.overview: In part one of this short-lived housing horror, a woman sues her ex-landlord over a trial lease that went off the rails ending in non-stop texts, harassment and emotional distress.

videos.title: Rent Deposit Return Burn Part 2
videos.overview: In part two, the defense fires back with Ring-camera footage, restraining order drama and a claim that the entire case is built on lies from a serial accuser.

videos.title: Mommy Dearest
videos.overview: Forced from home at 13, a man is sued by his mother for alleged loans and legal fees, which he insists were gifts. He countersues, claiming she broke a promise to house his family, leaving them homeless.

videos.title: Furry Fatality
videos.overview: When a French bulldog is found dead in his own yard, his grieving owner alleges the neighbors' dogs are responsible for the fatal mauling. They deny any role in the attack but photos, vet reports and prior incidents paint a disturbing picture.

videos.title: From Locks to Lawsuit
videos.overview: After nine years with dreadlocks, a man experiences a spiritual awakening and visits a barber to cut them off. The transformation turned traumatic when he lands in the ER with scalp abrasions. Claiming dirty tools were to blame, he sued the barber for over $9,000 for his injuries.

videos.title: Foul Play
videos.overview: When fundraising money for a youth football team goes missing, an assistant coach and three moms accuse the so-called "team mom" of embezzling $9,000. She denies all charges and fires back with a $10K defamation countersuit.

videos.title: The Brunette Burn
videos.overview: A routine salon visit spirals into a $9K legal clash when a woman claims a botched dye job triggered a severe allergic reaction. The stylist fires back with a countersuit over damaging online reviews.

videos.title: Airbnb Shenanigans
videos.overview: A landlord demands $4,800 in rent and utilities but her former tenant says he did housework for free and was never told the rules were changing. After getting served at work and hit with angry texts, he claims emotional distress and insists he owes far less.

videos.title: Demo Disaster
videos.overview: A Detroit home is hit by fire, a fallen tree and repeated thefts... only to be demolished as a community eyesore. The owner blames a family friend for a cleanup and sues him for $3K in city fines as well as pain and suffering.

videos.title: The Boat Lift Grift
videos.overview: A Minnesota lakefront deal sinks fast when a man hires someone to sell his pontoon lift, only to learn it was secretly sold, the cash pocketed and the job left unfinished.

videos.title: Bad Dog Sitter
videos.overview: A veteran dog sitter/trainer lost control of a friend's puppy, who escaped and was hit by a car, resulting in leg amputation. The dog owner sued for the $10K court max to pay for veterinary bills and emotional distress.

videos.title: Slum Lord vs Squatter
videos.overview: Emotional support animals in a no-pets apartment spark a $10K legal battle between a landlord and his tenant. The landlord claims unpaid rent and property damage; the tenant says he was locked out, spied on and forced to live among fruit flies.

videos.title: Salvaged Surprise
videos.overview: A family buys a Honda Civic they can't register or insure and says the seller hid that it was stolen, salvaged and rigged to hide engine issues.

videos.title: Frost, Floods and Forgotten Ladders
videos.overview: A dream sunroom turns into a construction nightmare when a woman's contractor vanishes mid-job. He blames a streak of bad luck and now faces a $4,500 lawsuit over ruined materials and emotional distress.

videos.title: Payoff Playoff
videos.overview: Ex-fiancés' peaceful breakup is tested in court years later, as he demands money for unpaid loans and tools, while she insists the $25,000 buyout settled everything, even if the house is now worth ten times that.
